### Summary of Parsing:
- **Filtering**: Filtered log entries to include only those with levels `ERROR` or `CRITICAL` (case-insensitive).
- **Timestamps**: Converted all entry timestamps with various UTC offsets (`Z`, `+07:00`, `-05:00`) to UTC in ISO format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).
- **Levels & Messages**: Extracted upper-case log levels and the exact message text following the service name.
- **Exceptions**: Extracted the final line of any attached tracebacks (or set to `null` when no traceback was present).
- **Repeat Counts**: Computed `repeat_count` as $1 + \text{sum}(N)$ from any `-- last message repeated N times --` lines following the entry.
- **Service Counts**: Calculated aggregated totals (`counts_by_service`) per service summing up the repeat counts.
